n: Recorded seaborne country pairs (CEPII BACI) whose route, as the atlas assumes it, crosses the passage. Rows marked 1 have to cross it: every recorded seaborne pair whose assumed route has to cross this passage, the 'at least' figure. Rows marked 0 may use it or a parallel passage of similar length, or load or discharge on another coast: added, they give the 'up to' figure. Mixed sea-and-land pairs, pairs that could not be routed and trades that customs data do not record are not in it.
